title: California Business and Professions Code section 7071.9 - Qualifying individual's bond
claims: Section 7071.9(a)(1) provides that if the qualifying individual, as referred to in Sections 7068 and 7068.1, is neither the proprietor, a general partner, nor a joint licensee, the qualifying individual shall file or have on file a qualifying individual's bond as provided in Section 7071.10 in the sum of twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000), in addition to and not combined with any contractor's bond required by Sections 7071.5 to 7071.8, required for the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, or continued valid use of a license.
Section 7071.9(a)(2) provides that subdivision (a) shall not apply to a federally recognized tribe or a participating tribe.

Section 7071.9(b) provides that, excluding claims brought by the beneficiaries specified in paragraph (1) of subdivision (a) of Section 7071.10, the aggregate liability of a surety on claims against the bond shall not exceed seven thousand five hundred dollars ($7,500), that proceeds in excess of that sum are reserved exclusively for those beneficiaries, and that nothing in the section prevents those beneficiaries from claiming or recovering the full measure of the bond.

Section 7071.9(c) provides that the responsible managing officer of a corporation shall not be required to file a qualifying individual's bond if the responsible managing officer owns 10 percent or more of the voting stock of the corporation and certifies to that fact on a form prescribed by the registrar.

Section 7071.9(d) provides that the qualifying individual for a limited liability company shall not be required to file a qualifying individual's bond if the qualifying individual owns at least a 10-percent membership interest in the limited liability company and certifies to that fact on a form prescribed by the registrar.
The section carries the notation Amended by Stats. 2024, Ch. 485, Sec. 9 (SB 1455), effective January 1, 2025.
notes: Fetched 2026-09-30 from the publisher's own site and read in full. Subdivision (b) refers to paragraph (1) of subdivision (a) of section 7071.10, but section 7071.10 as read is lettered (a) through (e) without numbered paragraphs, and subdivision (a) of 7071.10 is the homeowner beneficiary. This record reports the cross-reference as written and does not resolve it.
